No temporary script or other temporary local file was created. Only this JSON evidence is retained.

observations.result: AWS CLI transport established assumed-role caller, successful DescribeTable, and successful UpdateTable after policy propagation before meaningful contrasts.

With source UpdateTable and documented target prerequisites allowed, omitted CreateTableReplica and source-only grants were denied naming the target us-east-2 table ARN and no session policy allow. Target-only CreateTableReplica succeeded and the native target table became ACTIVE.

With source UpdateTable and target DeleteTable allowed, omitted DeleteTableReplica and source-only grants were denied naming the target us-east-2 table ARN and no session policy allow. Target-only DeleteTableReplica succeeded; target absence and source demotion were observed.
A DescribeTable-only role session was denied UpdateTable on the source ARN by the AWS CLI transport. Raw transport disagreement invalidates the earlier raw role attribution, not this native denial.

After narrowing the owned identity policy to source DescribeTable/UpdateTable, GetItem transitioned from Success to identity-policy AccessDeniedException, while source DescribeTable and UpdateTable stayed successful. Replica creation was denied naming dynamodb:Scan on the target ARN. This is not an isolated CreateTableReplica identity-policy test.
Authorized creation succeeded without any IAM permissions in the owned role or its session; the preexisting replication SLR retained the same RoleId and was never modified.
